sources.label: Official Weird Fish Sizing Guide (Women's Clothing: chest/waist/lower hip, in/cm)

audit: Old /size-guide 404s; guide is /info/sizing-info (linked as 'See full size guide' from product pages). Women's Clothing chart prints UK 8-22 with inches and cm per cell (printed cm used). 'Chest' stored as chest, 'Lower Hip' as hips. UK 10 89/72/95 -> 89/70/95; UK 14 99/82/105 -> 99/80/105; UK 18 111/94/117 -> 111/92/117. UK 20, 22 added. US/EU removed (not printed). Separate Women's Trousers chart (larger waist/hip values) not stored.
